I own the light blue monopoly (Oriental, Vermont, Connecticut) and both utilities, so those stay. Atlantic and Kentucky are standalone properties since I don't own their partners, making them the best mortgage candidates — Atlantic (130) plus Baltic (30) covers the $144 I need.
